Following their occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in circa [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] used a '''communications center''' to block all communications on the world, preventing the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] from learning of the invasion. The [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]] of the [[Dreaming River Clan]] attempted to infiltrate the communications center, but every infiltrator they sent was detected by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] that were [[Project Nightsaber|aiding]] the Imperials. A group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] agents and the former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guardsman]] [[Kir Kanos]] staged an attack on the facility, and the agents made their way to the buildings command center, where they confronted the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vit]] and the rogue Jedi student [[Dal Konur]].
